data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Fisher01–25: choose individually; state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Who opts in?
